correctness.rationale: On sunlet C_n∘K_1 (n≥3), an initially white leaf prevents its initially blue center from forcing along the cycle until adjacent cycle centers are already blue; only initially blue leaves B can start center-to-center forces. Encode initially both-white centers E and build cyclic B–E alternating graph H_S. Every component containing E is removable exactly when a degree-one B endpoint exists; fully alternating even rings have none. Weighted three-letter closed-walk transfer on the source five-state matrix, correcting the two fictitious walks per alternating cyclic word, yields trace(T^n)−4[z(1+z)]^{n/2} on even n and the stated rational series with a=z(z+2), b=2z(z+1), c=z²(1+z)². Formal extraction gives minimum counts 4(2^{n/2−1}−1) for even n and 3n2^{(n−3)/2} for odd n (minimum size ceil(n/2)). Independent brute zero forcing over all 2^{2n} initial sets n=3..8 matched the H_S criterion, the polynomial and minimum counts, and an independent symbolic 5×5 trace determinant check passed. General all-n result rests on combinatorial induction/transfer, not finite run.
